column1: # Short English names for the characters and items that appear in card Ids.
# Columns: japanese <TAB> english <TAB> number of cards using the name.
# The third column is informational; generate_card_names.js reads the first two.
# These are the *short* names the card plate needs, not the full names -- the
# plate clips text centred, so "Naked Crook Mofus" would lose both its head and
# its tail. Full names come from カード情報 instead and are used in the combat log.
# mistranslated_names.json overrides the english column wherever the two
# disagree, so card labels spell names the same way the dialogue does. See the
# exception list in generate_card_names.js for the handful of entries where the
# override is refused because it would erase a distinction between cards.
伝説の武具モンスター
ケッセルリンクメダル
